caption: The drawing features a detailed rendering of a single ornate object, resembling a chalice or lamp, which is centrally placed on a light beige background. The main object is vertically symmetrical, resting on a square base with a broad, rounded lower section that gently narrows into a slender and elaborately shaped stem. The upper half expands into a bulbous, segmented body decorated with carved patterns, followed by a smaller, rounded cap adorned with two thin, angled cylindrical rods protruding from the top. The rods are a light golden-yellow color, while the rest of the object is in shades of grey, highlighting metallic texture and surface decorations. The primary object is rendered with fine shading to emphasize its three-dimensional form and intricate detailing. In the upper left corner, there is an inset technical sketch of the same object, showing its side profile, overall dimensions, and proportions in black outline. The background remains plain and unadorned, focusing attention solely on the depicted object.
title: Lamp
